# Available variables:
#  - env: environment on which the action is triggered
#  - model: model of the record on which the action is triggered; is a void recordset
#  - record: record on which the action is triggered; may be void
#  - records: recordset of all records on which the action is triggered in multi-mode; may be void
#  - time, datetime, dateutil, timezone: useful Python libraries
#  - float_compare: utility function to compare floats based on specific precision
#  - b64encode, b64decode: functions to encode/decode binary data
#  - log: log(message, level='info'): logging function to record debug information in ir.logging table
#  - _logger: _logger.info(message): logger to emit messages in server logs
#  - UserError: exception class for raising user-facing warning messages
#  - Command: x2many commands namespace
# To return an action, assign: action = {...}

# We use the pre-loaded dateutil, so no 'import' statement is needed!

if record.payment_term_id:
    term_name = record.payment_term_id.name.lower()
    
    # SCENARIO A: Direct Purchase
    if 'direct' in term_name:
        # Use .update() instead of the equals sign to bypass the STORE_ATTR error
        record.update({
            'plan_id': False,
            'end_date': False
        })
        
    # SCENARIO B: Rent-to-Own
    else:
        # Figure out how many months based on the payment term name
        months_to_add = 0
        if '6' in term_name: months_to_add = 6
        elif '12' in term_name: months_to_add = 12
        elif '24' in term_name: months_to_add = 24
        elif '36' in term_name: months_to_add = 36
        elif '48' in term_name: months_to_add = 48
        elif '60' in term_name: months_to_add = 60
        
        if months_to_add > 0:
            vals_to_update = {}
            
            # 1. Apply the Monthly plan
            if not record.plan_id:
                monthly_plan = env['sale.subscription.plan'].search([
                    ('billing_period_value', '=', 1), 
                    ('billing_period_unit', '=', 'month')
                ], limit=1)
                
                if monthly_plan:
                    vals_to_update['plan_id'] = monthly_plan.id
                    
            # 2. Set the end date using the pre-loaded dateutil library
            if record.date_order:
                vals_to_update['end_date'] = record.date_order + dateutil.relativedelta.relativedelta(months=months_to_add)
            
            # Apply all updates at once safely
            if vals_to_update:
                record.update(vals_to_update)
